profile.headline: Java Software Engineer at Mountain View Software Corp
profile.geoLocationName: Four Oaks, North Carolina, United States
profile.summary: Experienced Java software developer with a strong background in quality assurance and a demonstrated history of working in the computer software industry. Skilled in Java, Spring, Angular, automated testing, and SQL. Bachelor of Science (BS) focused in Management Information Systems, General from Southern Utah University.

positions.title: Quality Assurance Engineer
positions.description:
•	Lead QA efforts in rolling out a Java Spring Web application for transforming, validating,
previewing, and publishing digital content 
•	Develop and maintain testing tools that scan digital content for errors
•	Write automated tests to make transforming content more streamlined

company.name: The Church of Jesus Christ of Latter-day Saints

positions.title: Testing Center Technician/Proctor
positions.description:
•	Run readiness testing software for computer-based tests 
•	Troubleshoot networking issues 
•	Check in test takers 
•	Proctor exams

positions.title: IT Help Desk Technician
positions.description:
•	Troubleshoot and resolve faculty and student computer-related issues campus-wide
•	Assist and train faculty and staff in technology migrations
•	Set up computer labs

positions.title: Part-time Merchandiser
positions.description:
•	Throw loads at major grocery stores
•	Coordinate with grocery managers to set up displays 
•	Work back stock product

positions.title: Freelance Web Design
positions.description:
•	Design and develop Web sites for small businesses, organizations, and events
•	Design small-scale MySQL e-commerce databases with PHP on the backend
•	Most sites are responsive with Bootstrap framework
•	E-portfolio:  http://familiarmelodies.com/neiljohnson/

positions.title: Teaching Assistant
positions.description: I was a teaching assistant for Web Development and E-Commerce classes.  My roles were to grade assignments, assist students in their projects, proctor exams, and give lectures when Dr. Wu was not present.

company.name: Dr. Wu's Web Development and E-Commerce

honors.title: LDS Mission to Hamburg Germany
honors.description: I served two years in Germany as an LDS missionary. There I served the people and became fluent in German.

honors.title: Eagle Scout Award
honors.description: The Eagle Scout Award is the most prestigious award that a Boy Scout can earn. The scout must, among other things, earn 21 merit badges, complete an Eagle Scout project, and complete an Eagle Board of Review.
honors.issuer: Issued by Boy Scouts of America · May 2007

projects.title: Hello Gorgeous Hair and Spa
projects.description: The local hair salon needed help with marketing. As a solution, a few of us created this website from scratch to help enhance online marketing (through one summer, the business revenue increased significantly).
